archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Adapted for Logistics)

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen shadow-2xl relative flex flex-col bg-dark_background overflow-x-hidden
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-5, p-6. High density for driver info, generous touch targets (min 48px height for inputs/buttons)
layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom, w-full max-w-md mx-auto z-50 pb-safe h-20 flex items-center justify-around bg-dark_surface border-t border-dark_border rounded-t-2xl

components.buttons: Large tap targets (h-14). Primary: bg-orange-500 text-white rounded-2xl font-bold text-lg w-full transition-transform active:scale-95.
components.inputs: h-14 rounded-2xl px-4 text-base. Light mode (Login): bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200. Focus: ring-2 ring-orange-500. Dark mode (Profile): bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-white.
components.cards: Rounded-[24px]. Dark mode: bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-5 shadow-sm.
components.badges: Rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider.

login_screen.visuals: Top and bottom orange wave vectors (use SVG background). Centered Scooter logo (logo_light). Large welcome text ('Salut, Livrator!'). Rounded input fields for Email and Password. Full-width orange login button.

home_screen.visuals: Orange wave at top (SVG). Centered logo (logo_dark). Greeting ('Salut, [Name]'). Order volume stats card. Current active order card showing pickup to delivery route overview. Summary today (earnings/deliveries).

delivery_screen.visuals: State 1: 'Offline' (Shows large 'Intră în program' toggle/button). State 2: 'Active' (Shows map interface, step-by-step delivery checklist, customer contact buttons, swipe-to-complete delivery slider).

calendar_screen.visuals: Shadcn Calendar customized for dark mode. Shows shifts/schedule. List below calendar showing upcoming shift times.

profile_screen.visuals: Avatar upload UI at top. Form fields: Name, DOB (Datepicker), Gender (Radio or Select: Masculin/Feminin), Email (with 'Validare' CTA next to it & verified badge), Phone (with format validation UI & 'Validare' CTA). Toggle for shift status.

images.description: ProDelivery scooter logo for Light mode (Login)
ProDelivery scooter logo for Dark mode (Dashboard/Home)

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The entire app must be wrapped in a mobile simulator container: `<div className="w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl bg-black overflow-hidden">` to satisfy the 'optimizezi cum se vede pe telefon' requirement on desktop.
The app has two distinct themes as requested: Login is strictly LIGHT MODE (bg-white with orange waves), and post-login is strictly DARK MODE (bg-[#0A0A0A] with orange accents).
Implement the Orange Waves using inline SVG paths or custom CSS shapes positioned absolutely at the top (and bottom for login).
Use 'lucide-react' for all iconography (Home, Map/Delivery, Calendar, User).
Profile inputs (Email, Phone) MUST have a distinct 'Validare' (Validate) state and button. Use Shadcn Dialog to simulate entering an OTP code.
Navigation tabs: Acasă, Livrare, Calendar, Profil. Hide bottom nav on Login screen.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY interactive element (inputs, buttons, tabs, toggles).
Ensure large tap targets (minimum h-12 to h-14) for all buttons and inputs to adhere to 2026 driver app UX standards.
